Itinerary

Day by day

1Day 1Casablanca

Pick up at the Casablanca airport and transfer to your hotel.

Hassan II Mosque

You can start your day visiting the famous Hassan II Mosque, the largest religious building in the world open to non-Muslims. Its magnificent design combines modern engineering and traditional Moroccan craftsmanship.

Old Medina

Walk through the souk in the old medina, passing Bab Marrakech and its charming small hotels built during the protectorate. Discover the authentic daily life of locals.

United Nations Square

A vibrant hub connecting the old and modern parts of Casablanca — surrounded by shops, cafés, and historic hotels like Hyatt Regency.

The Corniche & Morocco Mall

Visit the seaside promenade of Ain Diab, filled with cafés, beaches, and the Morocco Mall — Africa’s second-largest shopping center.

2Day 2Casablanca · Rabat

After breakfast, depart to Rabat — Morocco’s political and administrative capital.

Visit the Kasbah of the Udayas, the Mausoleum of Mohammed V, and the impressive Hassan Tower. Stroll through the Andalusian Gardens and the charming medina filled with artisan shops.

Explore the Chellah Necropolis, an ancient Roman site later used as a royal burial ground. Overnight stay in Rabat.

3Day 3Rabat · Meknes · Fes

After breakfast, drive to Meknes, one of Morocco’s imperial cities. Begin your visit at Bab Mansour, the grand gate facing El Hedim Square. Explore the Dar Jamaï Museum, showcasing traditional Moroccan arts, woodwork, and ceramics.

Later, continue to Fes, the country’s oldest imperial city, and check in at your traditional riad.

4Day 4Fes · Moulay Idriss · Volubilis

Depart for a two-hour drive to explore Volubilis, Morocco’s most famous Roman ruins and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Discover ancient mosaics, temples, and arches that tell the story of Roman civilization in North Africa.

Continue to the holy town of Moulay Idriss, beautifully perched on twin hills, and enjoy panoramic views. Return to Fes for dinner and overnight stay.

5Day 5Explore Fes

After breakfast, begin a full-day guided tour of Fes, Morocco’s cultural and spiritual heart.

Visit the Bou Inania Madrasa, Kairaouine Mosque and University, Nejjarine Fountain, and the famous tanneries. Explore the Jewish quarter (Mellah) and see the coexistence of different communities.

Discover key sites such as:

  • Medersa Bou Inania
  • University of Al Karaouine
  • Medersa el Attarin
  • Zaouia Moulay Idriss II
  • Dar Batha Museum

Spend the evening relaxing in your riad or exploring the medina at leisure.

6Day 6Fes · Beni Mellal · Marrakech

Travel through the Middle Atlas Mountains toward Beni Mellal, surrounded by olive and orange groves. Stop for a traditional Berber lunch and explore the area’s scenic waterfalls and old kasbahs.

Continue through Kasba Tadla, a garrison town built by Moulay Ismail in the 17th century, before arriving in Marrakech in the evening. Overnight stay in Marrakech.

7Day 7Tour of Marrakech

Discover Marrakech, the “Red City,” starting with the Koutoubia Mosque and the vibrant Jemaa El Fna square. Wander through the souks filled with carpets, spices, jewelry, and crafts.

Visit:

  • Saadian Tombs
  • El Badii Palace
  • Bahia Palace
  • Mellah (Jewish Quarter)
  • Majorelle Gardens

Enjoy a delicious lunch and conclude the evening with the Chez Ali Fantasia dinner show before returning to your riad.

8Day 8Marrakech · Casablanca

After breakfast, transfer back to Casablanca for your departure flight.
Your Morocco Historical Cities Tour comes to an end — with unforgettable memories and experiences.
